name: 104 - API - Manage Services and Doctor Assignments - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT $1::TEXT action,$2::TEXT clinic_name,NULLIF($3::BIGINT,0) service_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT,'') service_name,NULLIF($5::TEXT,'') description,
        $6::INTEGER duration_minutes,$7::NUMERIC price_amount,$8::TEXT currency,
        $9::BOOLEAN requires_previsit_guidance,NULLIF($10::BIGINT,0) doctor_id,
        NULLIF($11::TEXT,'') doctor_name,NULLIF($12::INTEGER,0) custom_duration_minutes,
        NULLIF($13::NUMERIC,0) custom_price_amount,$14::JSONB metadata,
        NULLIF($15::TEXT,'') actor_name,$16::TEXT source_channel,$17::INTEGER result_limit
),
c AS (
 SELECT clinics.id clinic_id,r.*
 FROM clinics,r WHERE clinics.name=r.clinic_name LIMIT 1
),
service_target AS (
 SELECT s.*
 FROM services s,c
 WHERE s.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
   AND ((c.service_id IS NOT NULL AND s.id=c.service_id)
     OR (c.service_id IS NULL AND c.service_name IS NOT NULL AND s.name=c.service_name))
 ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 1
),
doctor_target AS (
 SELECT d.*
 FROM doctors d,c
 WHERE d.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
   AND ((c.doctor_id IS NOT NULL AND d.id=c.doctor_id)
     OR (c.doctor_id IS NULL AND c.doctor_name IS NOT NULL AND d.full_name=c.doctor_name))
 ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 1
),
inserted_service AS (
 INSERT INTO services(
   clinic_id,name,description,duration_minutes,price_amount,currency,
   requires_previsit_guidance,is_active,metadata,updated_at
 )
 SELECT c.clinic_id,c.service_name,c.description,c.duration_minutes,c.price_amount,
        c.currency,c.requires_previsit_guidance,TRUE,c.metadata,NOW()
 FROM c
 WHERE c.action='create' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_target)
 RETURNING *
),
updated_service AS (
 UPDATE services s
 SET name=CASE WHEN c.action='update' AND c.service_name IS NOT NULL THEN c.service_name ELSE s.name END,
     description=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN COALESCE(c.description,s.description) ELSE s.description END,
     duration_minutes=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.duration_minutes ELSE s.duration_minutes END,
     price_amount=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.price_amount ELSE s.price_amount END,
     currency=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.currency ELSE s.currency END,
     requires_previsit_guidance=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.requires_previsit_guidance ELSE s.requires_previsit_guidance END,
     metadata=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN s.metadata||c.metadata ELSE s.metadata END,
     is_active=CASE WHEN c.action='activate' THEN TRUE WHEN c.action='deactivate' THEN FALSE ELSE s.is_active END,
     updated_at=NOW()
 FROM c
 WHERE s.id=(SELECT id FROM service_target)
   AND c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate')
 RETURNING s.*
),
effective_service AS (
 SELECT inserted_service.* FROM inserted_service
 UNION ALL SELECT updated_service.* FROM updated_service
 UNION ALL SELECT service_target.* FROM service_target,c WHERE c.action IN ('get','assign_doctor','unassign_doctor','list_doctors')
 LIMIT 1
),
assignment AS (
 INSERT INTO doctor_services(
   clinic_id,doctor_id,service_id,is_active,custom_duration_minutes,
   custom_price_amount,metadata,updated_at
 )
 SELECT c.clinic_id,d.id,s.id,TRUE,c.custom_duration_minutes,
        c.custom_price_amount,c.metadata,NOW()
 FROM c
 CROSS JOIN doctor_target d
 CROSS JOIN effective_service s
 WHERE c.action='assign_doctor'
 ON CONFLICT(doctor_id,service_id) DO UPDATE SET
   is_active=TRUE,
   custom_duration_minutes=EXCLUDED.custom_duration_minutes,
   custom_price_amount=EXCLUDED.custom_price_amount,
   metadata=doctor_services.metadata||EXCLUDED.metadata,
   updated_at=NOW()
 RETURNING *
),
unassigned AS (
 UPDATE doctor_services ds
 SET is_active=FALSE,updated_at=NOW()
 FROM c,doctor_target d,effective_service s
 WHERE c.action='unassign_doctor'
   AND ds.doctor_id=d.id
   AND ds.service_id=s.id
 RETURNING ds.*
),
admin_event AS (
 INSERT INTO clinic_admin_events(
   clinic_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,actor_name,source_channel,before_data,after_data
 )
 SELECT
   c.clinic_id,
   CASE WHEN c.action IN ('assign_doctor','unassign_doctor') THEN 'doctor_service' ELSE 'service' END,
   CASE WHEN c.action='assign_doctor' THEN (SELECT id FROM assignment)
        WHEN c.action='unassign_doctor' THEN (SELECT id FROM unassigned)
        ELSE COALESCE((SELECT id FROM effective_service),(SELECT id FROM service_target)) END,
   c.action,c.actor_name,c.source_channel,
   CASE WHEN c.action IN ('assign_doctor','unassign_doctor') THEN '{}'::JSONB
        ELSE COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(service_target) FROM service_target),'{}'::JSONB) END,
   CASE WHEN c.action='assign_doctor' THEN COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(assignment) FROM assignment),'{}'::JSONB)
        WHEN c.action='unassign_doctor' THEN COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(unassigned) FROM unassigned),'{}'::JSONB)
        ELSE COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(effective_service) FROM effective_service),'{}'::JSONB) END
 FROM c
 WHERE c.action IN ('create','update','activate','deactivate','assign_doctor','unassign_doctor')
   AND (
     EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective_service)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignment)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unassigned)
   )
 RETURNING id
),
listed AS (
 SELECT s.id,s.name,s.description,s.duration_minutes,s.price_amount,s.currency,
        s.requires_previsit_guidance,s.is_active,s.metadata,s.created_at,s.updated_at,
        COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doctor_services ds WHERE ds.service_id=s.id AND ds.is_active=TRUE),0) active_doctor_count
 FROM services s,c
 WHERE c.action='list' AND s.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
 ORDER BY s.name,s.id
 LIMIT (SELECT result_limit FROM c)
),
assigned_doctors AS (
 SELECT d.id doctor_id,d.full_name doctor_name,d.specialty,d.is_active doctor_active,
        ds.id assignment_id,ds.is_active assignment_active,
        COALESCE(ds.custom_duration_minutes,s.duration_minutes) effective_duration_minutes,
        COALESCE(ds.custom_price_amount,s.price_amount) effective_price_amount
 FROM effective_service s
 JOIN doctor_services ds ON ds.service_id=s.id
 JOIN doctors d ON d.id=ds.doctor_id
 CROSS JOIN c
 WHERE c.action='list_doctors'
 ORDER BY d.full_name,d.id
)
SELECT
 CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN FALSE
      WHEN c.action='create' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_target) THEN FALSE
      WHEN c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get','assign_doctor','unassign_doctor','list_doctors') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_target) THEN FALSE
      WHEN c.action IN ('assign_doctor','unassign_doctor') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM doctor_target) THEN FALSE
      WHEN c.action='unassign_doctor' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unassigned) THEN FALSE
      ELSE TRUE END success,
 CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
      WHEN c.action='create' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_target) THEN 'service_already_exists'
      WHEN c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get','assign_doctor','unassign_doctor','list_doctors') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_target) THEN 'service_not_found'
      WHEN c.action IN ('assign_doctor','unassign_doctor') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM doctor_target) THEN 'doctor_not_found'
      WHEN c.action='unassign_doctor' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unassigned) THEN 'doctor_service_assignment_not_found'
      WHEN c.action='create' THEN 'service_created'
      WHEN c.action='update' THEN 'service_updated'
      WHEN c.action='activate' THEN 'service_activated'
      WHEN c.action='deactivate' THEN 'service_deactivated'
      WHEN c.action='assign_doctor' THEN 'doctor_assigned_to_service'
      WHEN c.action='unassign_doctor' THEN 'doctor_unassigned_from_service'
      WHEN c.action='list_doctors' THEN 'service_doctors_listed'
      WHEN c.action='get' THEN 'service_loaded'
      ELSE 'services_listed' END result,
 (SELECT TO_JSONB(effective_service) FROM effective_service) service,
 (SELECT TO_JSONB(assignment) FROM assignment) doctor_service_assignment,
 (SELECT TO_JSONB(unassigned) FROM unassigned) removed_assignment,
 COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) services,
 COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(assigned_doctors)) FROM assigned_doctors),'[]'::JSONB) doctors,
 (SELECT id FROM admin_event) admin_event_id
FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT FALSE,'clinic_not_found',NULL::JSONB,NULL::JSONB,NULL::JSONB,'[]'::JSONB,'[]'::JSONB,NULL::BIGINT
FROM r WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c);

parameters.content:
## مدیریت خدمات و تخصیص پزشک

اقدام‌ها: create, update, activate, deactivate, get, list, assign_doctor, unassign_doctor, list_doctors
